newsitem.title: USA: Sonat 2nd Pinnacle well tests 23 mln cu ft.
newsitem.headline: Sonat 2nd Pinnacle well tests 23 mln cu ft.

text.p: Sonat Inc's oil and natural gas exploration and production subsidiary said its second Pinnacle Reef well tested at a rate of 23 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
Sonat Exploration Company said in a statement it believed the gross recoverable natural gas reserves from the well -- the Scurlock No. 1 -- to be in the range of 40 billion to 50 billion cubic feet.

This was consistent with the company's expectations, it said. The well was located in the Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef Trend in the Bear Grass area of Leon County, Texas and Sonat had a 67 percent working interest.
The company said it began selling natural gas from Scurlock on September 27.
Sonat said it was drilling two more Pinnacle Reef tests on prospects in the Bear Grass area.
